xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:NameOfTheOpposingParty: Asst.Commissioner of Comercial Taxes - Audit 3 Kalaburgi
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:StatusOfTheLitigationDisputeAs: The matter initially pertained to the non-payment of output tax on the corporate guarantee provided to subsidiaries and was taken up by the Enforcement Authority. In response, the company submitted a reply requesting the dropping of the demand proceedings. Following this, the case has now been transferred and is currently under the jurisdiction of the Assistant Commissioner of Commercial Taxes – Audit-3, Kalaburagi.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:CurrentStatusOfTheLitigationOr: The Company has prefered Appeal againt the order passed by Asst. Commissioner of Commercial taxes - Audit -3 Kalaburgi before the Honarable "Joint Commissioner of Commercial Tax (Appeal ) Kalaburgi Division - Kulbargi -Awaiting personal hearing
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:StatusOfTheLitigationDisputeAs: The company filed a application before the Authority for Advance Ruling (AAR) seeking clarification on transfer of Input tax credit on business transfer from AP to Karnataka under the Same PAN. The AAR had given ruling in favour of the Company which was challange by the Department. and the Appeallate Authority for Advance Ruling (AAAR) reversed the Advance Ruling . Subsequently, the Company has filed a writ petition challenging the said order before the Hon'ble High Court of VIjayawada on 02.08.2021 and the matter is pending.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:CurrentStatusOfTheLitigationOr: Both the parties presented their arguments before the Hon'ble High Court of Vijayawada on 05 January 2026. Outcome awaited.
